_instructions.purpose: Optional ingestion contract for future/current rookie prospects. Add rows via agent/data pipeline; do not hand-fill if reliable source data is unavailable.
_instructions.normalization: Except draft_capital_pick and raw age/breakout_age, quality metrics should preferably be normalized 0..1 within position/class or historical cohort.
_instructions.market_rookie_rank: Consensus/market rookie rank. Lower is better.
_instructions.model_rookie_rank: Optional. The engine calculates its own rank when absent.
